method: Direct visual correspondence against the same full original JPEG, using source-region position and physical identity before checking kind, value or color. The frozen reference was not edited.

statuses.matched: same visible physical object/marking at corresponding source area
statuses.representation-only: numeric meaning appears on terrain but no distinct physical number-disc component
statuses.uncertain: plausible source-area relation but printed marking identity/box is not secure

notes: Its prose mentions colored pieces, but no such components occur in the parsed board.layout.
The board.layout claims full coverage although roads/buildings/harbors and distinct number-disc objects are absent.
These four unmatched output IDs are not automatically hallucinations; the frozen human census may have merged or missed small pieces/coastal markings.
Its owner IDs and exact canonical road/vertex/harbor slots are not independently established by the frozen visual reference and are not scored here.
A printed harbor marking as a board-state component must not be mistaken for a separate movable wooden piece.

valueDisputes.assessment: disputed, not a confirmed model error
valueDisputes.reason: The number face is rotated/soft in the original and, on reinspection, resembles 4; the frozen medium-confidence interpretation may be wrong. Preserve the original 9 and exclude this disputed item from any claim of confirmed model error.

unknownValueExclusions.reason: Frozen numeral is null/illegible; both models say 3 but that is not a validated correct answer.
Robber obscures the numeral; both models preserve null.

suspectedReferenceErrorsOrOmissions.photoEvidence: A narrow upright blue shape directly above the blue building around x300-350,y420-505 may be a separate road; the original p02 envelope included both. A separate kind/count cannot be certified from this view.
A pale narrow shape near x410-468,y796-842 beside the lower mountain/building appears separate from p12 and p13, but is low contrast.
A small coastal icon is visible near x866-936,y546-624 east of the middle-right field; the original coastal census annotated only six markings.

The frozen top-left printed marking was boxed at x62-110,y399-431 while this output is farther right at about x129-199,y374-421. The coast is partly cropped and the two could be different printed details.

unmatchedOutputStillUncertain.reason: Pale top-edge shape at about x468-503,y390-437 may be a physical road or board/coast artwork; no reliable independent kind decision from this image.

limitations: The frozen reference is an independent visual interpretation, not certified whole-board ground truth; no reference values or boxes were changed after seeing either model.
Number discs, printed harbors and colored wooden pieces are different physical/representation layers. An embedded number property is semantic reading, not separate disc detection.

Source-region correspondence was reviewed visually. Canonical q/r edge and vertex topology, owner identity, and exact harbor trade types were not independently annotated, so their accuracy remains unknown.
One photo and one response per model cannot establish general model accuracy or reliability.
